title: Where Is the "Self" of a Large Language Model? -- From Self-Index to Self-Reference
abstract: arXiv:2610.16717v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Does a large language model have a self, and if so, of what kind? We separate two functional levels familiar from biology: a self-index, which distinguishes one's own material from external material and shapes processing, as corollary discharge does in nearly all animals, and self-reference, the higher ability to recognize what is one's own, as in mirror self-recognition. We probe both in Qwen3.8-27B by placing the same text in an Assistant, a User, or a System message rendered by the model's own chat template, and report three levels of evidence. Persistence: as predicted in advance, the representation of the text separates the model's own message from both external sources at all 64 layers and for every test text, along a shared direction, even when the answer does not depend on who supplied the text. Coupling: asked who wrote the preceding message, the model claims its own messages (0.77) and assigns User and System messages alike

translated_title: 大语言模型的“自我”在哪里？——从自我索引到自我指涉
translated_abstract: 大语言模型是否拥有“自我”？如果有，是何种类型的自我？我们区分了生物学中熟悉的两个功能层次：自我索引，即区分自身材料与外部材料并据此调整加工过程，如同几乎所有动物都具备的“伴随放电”机制；以及自我指涉，即更高层次的能力，能够识别哪些内容属于自己，类似镜像自我识别。我们在Qwen3.8-27B模型上探测这两个层次，方法是将同一段文本放置在由模型自身聊天模板渲染的Assistant、User或System消息中，并报告了三个层次的证据。持续性：正如预先预测的那样，文本的表征在全部64层中、对每一条测试文本，都能将模型自身的消息与两种外部来源区分开来，且沿着一个共同的方向，即使答案并不取决于文本的提供者。耦合性：当被问及前一条消息是谁写的时，模型会认领自己的消息（0.77），并对User和System消息作出相似的归属判断……
tldr: 该研究通过在模型自身消息与外部来源消息之间进行表征对比，首次证明大语言模型同时具备“自我索引”（在所有层中持续区分自身与外部文本）和“自我指涉”（能认领自己写的消息）两个类似生物功能层次的“自我”证据。
en_tdlr: This study provides the first evidence that a large language model exhibits both a self-index (persistently separating its own messages from external sources across all layers) and self-reference (claiming authorship of its own messages), suggesting a biologically analogous functional "self" in LLMs.
